title: THE CATAPULT · POWER PAIRS
why: Rested yesterday and the last card was all hips and hamstrings, so today is squat, push and pull with speed: every bell lift is paired with an explosive bodyweight move, then a sprint leg, on a strict two-minute clock. Twelve rounds, rest is whatever the clock leaves you.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A · shoulders / spine / hips + jump prime

items.name: Pogo hops ×20
items.detail: stiff ankles, quick off the floor

blocks.title: THE CATAPULT · 12 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: E2MOM · every 2:00 × 12 ROUNDS = 24:00 · one pair + one sprint leg per round · 6 pairs run twice · 2×45, 60 lb, 52 lb DB
blocks.format: One clock. On every 2:00: the round's bell lift, straight into its bodyweight partner, straight onto the belt for the sprint leg. Whatever is left of the 2:00 is rest. Rounds 1-6 = pairs 1-6, rounds 7-12 = pairs 1-6 again. Score = rounds finished inside their 2:00. Log rounds made, the first round that ran over, slowest pair and RPE.
blocks.workRest: SPRINT LEG every round: 0.10 mi flat at 9.0 mph (about 40 s). Rounds 7-12 at 9.5 if the first six all landed with 15 s to spare.

items.name: P1 · Double push press 2×45 ×8 → plyo push-up ×8
items.detail: hands leave the floor every rep

items.name: P3 · Bear-hug squat 60 lb ×10 → tuck jump ×8
items.detail: bell hugged to the chest, knees to the chest on the jump

items.name: P4 · Double high pull 2×45 ×10 → skater hop ×8/side
items.detail: side-to-side bound, land on one foot, hold a beat

items.name: P5 · Racked step-up 2×45 ×6/side on the bench → burpee ×6
P6 · Bench pullover 52 lb ×12 → bear crawl 10 yd out + back
items.detail: hips low, opposite hand and foot

blocks.noteGreen: Green (today): all 12 rounds inside the clock. Stretch: rounds 13-14 repeating P1 and P2 with the leg at 9.5.
blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 10 rounds, push press and high pull on the 35 lb, legs at 8.5.
blocks.text: Skater hop is new: push off one leg sideways, land on the other, knee soft, then bound back.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · halo + side bend + bird dog · straight through

items.name: Tall-kneeling halo 35 lb ×8 each way
items.detail: tight circles around the head, ribs down

items.name: Standing side bend 52 lb ×10/side
items.detail: DB at the side, slide it down the thigh, pull back up with the far-side obliques
